hero_sub: A messenger that belongs to you
hero_desc:
Chats, groups and channels, end-to-end encrypted calls, an AI assistant
and in-app coins. For Android and Linux. No ads, no tracking.
f1_desc: Text, photos, videos and documents with captions, plus voice messages. Replies, forwarding, reactions and delivery status.
f2_desc: Built-in AI chat powered by advanced language models, available anytime.
f3_desc: Audio and video calls over WebRTC — directly between devices when possible, otherwise via a relay.
f4_desc: Groups and channels with roles, comments, reactions and paid subscriptions. Live streams play inside the app.
f5_desc: Calls, text and attachments in direct chats are end-to-end encrypted: the key stays on your device and the server sees only ciphertext. Groups and channels are not yet — we say so plainly.
f6_desc: An in-app currency for premium, sticker packs and paid channels. Transfers between users included.

faq.a: A messenger for Android and Linux: chats, groups, channels with comments and streams, encrypted calls, a built-in AI assistant and in-app coins. No ads and no tracking.

Yes. The full messenger is free. Every day you get a free allowance — 15 AI requests, 200 MB of uploads, 10 relayed calls and 200 auto-translations; beyond it you pay in coins. Premium widens the allowance and raises the file limit to 20 MB: 🪙 1000 a month or 🪙 8400 a year.

Partly — and we say exactly where. Calls are end-to-end encrypted via WebRTC. In direct chats both the text and the attachments are encrypted — photos, videos, voice messages and documents, along with their captions: the key is created on your device and never leaves it, so the server holds only ciphertext, and we cannot read or restore it even at your request. Messages in groups and channels are still stored in the clear — that is the next step. Two honest caveats: the file name, its size and the length of a voice message remain visible to the server, because delivery and cleanup rely on them; and public keys are distributed by our server, so until safety numbers exist, the encryption protects against a database breach and outside access, but formally not against us.

An internal currency of the app: premium, sticker packs, paid channel subscriptions, transfers between users, and everything beyond the free daily allowance — AI requests, uploads, relayed calls, auto-translation. Registration grants 🪙 200. They are not money and not cryptocurrency, and cannot be exchanged for money.
Android and Linux. The beta is temporarily closed — we are polishing things and will reopen downloads. iOS and Windows are planned.

tok_plan_text: The wallet and the exchange of coins for the EION token are already built into the app — and they work. For now on a Solana test network: there the token has no value and can be neither bought nor sold. Whether a real launch happens depends on resources. There are no dates.

tok_disclaimer: Today coins are an internal accounting unit of the service. They are not money, securities or cryptocurrency, cannot be exchanged for money, and this page is not an offer to invest.
